d:
Enjoy “Raja Chalo Akele Mein” from the 1999 Hindi film Rajaji, featuring the much-loved on-screen pairing of Govinda and Raveena Tandon. Sung by Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik, this lively romantic number brings back the musical charm and feel-good vibes of 90s Bollywood.
Raja Chalo Akele Mein | Rajaji (1999) | Kumar Sanu Alka Yagnik | Govinda & Raveena Tandon Hit Song
Song: Raja Chalo Akele Mein
Movie: Rajaji (1999)
Star Cast: Govinda & Raveena Tandon
Singers: Kumar Sanu & Alka Yagnik
Music Director: Anand-Milind
Lyricist: Sameer
